name: Shadow Dexterous Hand
summary: A highly anthropomorphic research hand from the UK's Shadow Robot Company, with 24 joints (20 independently driven) closely matching human hand kinematics. Early versions used air-muscle actuation; current versions use electric motors with tendon drives. It is a long-standing standard for dexterous-manipulation research and was the hand used in OpenAI's in-hand Rubik's Cube work.
